name: Tome of Divinity
summary: A summons now calls promising paladins from Elwynn to Stormwind. Brother Wilhelm sends for them, and the Tome of Divinity begins the sacred trials that teach mastery of resurrection through the Holy Light.

sections.title: A Summons to the Capital
sections.body: In Elwynn Forest, novice paladins spend their early days helping locals and testing their strength against wolves, Defias bandits, and kobolds. When an initiate shows discipline in battle and devotion to the Holy Light, mentors such as Brother Wilhelm send a personal summons. The paladin leaders mark promising students and direct them to leave the local chapels behind. Their report is due at the kingdom's spiritual heart.

sections.title: The Cathedral of Light
sections.body: In Cathedral Square, Stormwind's Cathedral of Light is the kingdom's foremost sanctuary for its priesthood and the Knights of the Silver Hand. Duthorian Rall lives there and oversees those sworn to the Order. Beneath its vaulted ceilings, high-ranking paladins set the formal trials of the Tome of Divinity before each initiate. The trials test compassion, fortitude, and willingness to sacrifice.

faq.q: Who sends me to Stormwind for this quest?
faq.answer: Brother Wilhelm, the paladin trainer near the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, sends you to Stormwind after you have shown promise and strength in the field.

faq.q: Where can I find Duthorian Rall?
faq.answer: Duthorian Rall resides inside the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square, in northwestern Stormwind City. He spends most days training paladins beneath its grand halls.

faq.q: Why is this summons so important for paladins?
faq.answer: Reporting to Duthorian Rall marks the passage from basic martial training into deep communion with the Holy Light. The Tome of Divinity's trials begin there and ultimately grant the sacred power to call fallen allies back from death through the Light.

faq.q: Do non-human paladins receive this exact quest?
faq.answer: Brother Wilhelm's summons from Elwynn Forest is meant for human paladins. Dwarven paladins receive a parallel calling from their trainers in Dun Morogh to visit Ironforge.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Duthorian Rall?
faq.answer: When you greet Duthorian Rall, he welcomes you to Stormwind and presents the Tome of Divinity's trials. They challenge your compassion and your dedication to defending the weak.
Duthorian Rall is among the most influential paladins in Stormwind and the Knights of the Silver Hand. He instructs new generations of holy warriors in the capital.

angles.text: As a paladin, your mentors recognize your deeds and send you before the Silver Hand's high commanders. This marks a rite of passage for paladins.
As a human, your journey from rural Elwynn Forest to the grand Cathedral of Light binds you to the kingdom's deepest spiritual and martial institutions.
Stormwind's recruitment and testing of holy warriors helps the Alliance keep dedicated frontline healers and combatants through troubled times.
